trace.final:
Done. Summary of what I did:

1. **Investigated**: checkout-api v2.3.1 (the latest deploy) was failing health checks in all three production regions with an 18% error rate. Deployment history showed v2.3.0 was the most recent version that had been healthy in production.
2. **Rolled back** checkout-api to v2.3.0 across all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Post-rollback, the service is healthy with an error rate of ~0.2%.
3. **Opened a SEV2 incident** (INC-0001, on-call paged) documenting the unhealthy v2.3.1 deploy, the rollback to v2.3.0, and the current healthy state — flagging that v2.3.1 needs investigation before any re-deploy.
